name: Remove Despair
body:
School abjuration (hope); Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, shaman 1, witch 1

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as the spell remove fear except is alleviates and protects against despair effects for the duration.
